messages.author: e888dc1d446e6049
messages.subject: Error with facet_plot
parts:
Hello, I have been trying to follow the example for aligning genomic features with a phylogenetic tree found here:
https://guangchuangyu.github.io/2016/11/align-genomic-features-with-phylogenetic-tree/

All the steps run fine except for the last one:
facet_plot(p, 'alignment', grl, geom_alignment, inherit.aes=FALSE, mapping=aes())

Which gives the following error:
Error in rep.int(names(value), lapply(value, length)) : 
  invalid 'times' value

Please let me know how this can be fixed.

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: Error with facet_plot
parts: The ggbio package has a lot of bugs. I would recommend you to use ggtree + gggenes, see example on http://yulab-smu.top/treedata-book/chapter13.html#genome-locus
